_about: Formatting adjustments to PS1 English lines, each project decision (project rule: only PS1 text, formatting changes after approval). Applied by tools/build_text.py to the English tokens of the listed blocks (msg basename, case-insensitive + block hex). 'replace' swaps character runs ('{56}' = PS1 character code 0x56, for symbols such as the button icons); 'drop_page' removes the page (text up to and including its NEXT + CLEAR) that contains the given text. Every edit must match (asserted).

edits.why: Data's save help talks about a PS1 Memory card and its blocks. On the PSP: 'Memory Stick', and the block-count page goes. Target text (project decision): "If you want to save, come talk to me--you'll need a Memory Stick, too... If you get killed, you can restart from your previous save point by loading that game."

edits.approved: Project decision 2026-09-28 (button references follow the PSP control layout as the Japanese PSP script writes it); these blocks requested 2026-10-06
edits.why: On the PS1 (US) the cross button confirms and the triangle button cancels on the name-entry and donation screens; on the PSP the circle button confirms and the cross button cancels, and the Japanese PSP text of the same blocks says so. Only the two button icons change: cross -> circle (confirm), then triangle -> cross (cancel). Blocks: name entry at the TV station minigames (st08_03), name entry in st05, the donation amount in st06.
